subject: Subprocessor inspection slate and evidence timebox
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@silverlinebank.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subprocessor inspection scope + evidence window

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for taking this. Silverline is running a focused review of cloud processors supporting our new payments pipeline. We need to validate subprocessors, Art.28 controls and provide an excerpt from your Article 30 register. Our auditor (KPMG) will act as a third-party assessor; Adam Torres may join the call.

High-level asks:
- Full current subprocessor roster (name, country, role), plus any planned changes in the next 90 days.
- Export of Art.30 register entries relevant to payment processing (fields: processing purpose, categories, legal basis, onshore/offshore mapping).
- Evidence: SOC2 bridge letter (if available), KMS wrap metadata, recent ledger extracts showing access provisioning for service accounts.
- DPIA excerpt or summary specifically covering data flows for the payments feature.

Timebox: we are aiming for a 10-business-day remote evidence sprint starting as early as 2028-06-10. Please confirm whether that window works and whether you can provide an initial package (subprocessor roster + Art.30 excerpt + KMS notes) by 2028-06-07 so our team can review before the sprint.

Attachments: Subprocessor_List_v3.csv, QSA_RFI.xlsx (sample fields)

If there are any constrained items (e.g., on-prem access, escrowed logs), flag them now so we can coordinate logistics.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Third-Party Risk
Silverline Bank

---
From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@silverlinebank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor inspection scope + evidence window

Samantha —

Appreciate the detail. We can support a remote evidence sprint; a 10-business-day window is reasonable but I want to propose a slightly earlier prep milestone so we can triage any blockers.

Pre-sprint deliverables (we can deliver by 2028-06-07 if you confirm):
- Art.30 register excerpt (CSV of entries filtered by processing purpose).
- Current subprocessor roster (we will include planned changes flagged).
- High-level DPIA excerpt focused on payments data flows (PDF).
- KMS wrap metadata export and key-owner mappings (note: we cannot export keys; metadata only).

Two clarification questions:
1) Is the expectation full inspector rights (read-only live access to tenant logs) or a sampled remote export of requested artifacts?
2) Will KPMG need a signed NDA/inspection agreement for access to the ledger extracts?

For scope transparency: some vendors we depend on have contractual limits around live interactive access; in those cases we provide signed, time-limited ledger exports and an annotated sampling plan. If you can confirm the desired approach (live vs. exported sample) we will finalize the evidence sprint plan.

I will coordinate internal owners: Ben will take KMS and cert artifacts, Irene will pull Art.30/ledger excerpts, Marissa will own scheduling and the sprint plan. I will assemble the package and create a shared drive folder.

Attachments we will provide: art30_register_excerpt.pdf, processing_map_v1.drawio

Thanks — I will wait for your confirmation on the two questions and the sprint start date.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Quick operational note —

We should anticipate two common constraints and bake them into the sprint plan:
1) Subprocessor vendors often restrict interactive/live access; we will offer a timeboxed remote evidence sprint where vendors provide exported ledger slices and control assertions.
2) KMS key material cannot be exported; we will provide KMS wrap metadata, key rotation history, and HSM attestation logs if available.

Proposed sprint approach:
- Prep phase (3 business days): package export + reviewer access to drive folder. Internal dry-run to validate artifacts.
- Evidence sprint (10 business days): targeted artifact delivery, asynchronous Q&A, 2 x 30-min checkpoint calls.
- Wrap (2 business days): final attestations and access removal.

I'll draft an evidence_sprint_plan.md and share the folder link. Ben — can you confirm you can produce the KMS wrap export and the key-owner mapping by 2028-06-07? Irene — can you scope the ledger extracts (fields/time slices) we can safely export without breaking vendor contracts?

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Customer Trust
Redwood Inference

Thanks — that approach works for us. A few quick confirmations:
- Silverline prefers a remote sprint (exported artifacts) unless there is a regulatory reason to require on-site.
- We will need a signed inspection NDA before receiving ledger extracts (DocuSign link acceptable).
- Proposed sprint window: 2028-06-12 through 2028-06-25 (inclusive) — that gives us the weekend buffer. Is that OK?

Adam from KPMG is copied; he may provide a short checklist for the ledger fields he needs. Please include the sample column names in the prep package.

DocuSign NDA: https://docusign.com/recipient/12345

Samantha
